caption: FIGURE 1.32
note: text_layer was null; transcribed from the crop image. Only the artwork and its printed caption inside target_box_in_crop were transcribed: the Example 1.13 question text above the figure and the Solution prose below it lie outside that box and belong to other blocks, so they are excluded. Besides the four lettered labels the artwork carries a printed "+" at the central nucleus and many "-" signs spread over the sphere representing the uniform negative charge distribution; these are charge symbols drawn on the drawing rather than labelled items, so they are not listed in labels. The label "r" appears twice on different arrows (the short arrow from the nucleus to the inner circle, and the long arrow out to point P); labels are listed top-left to bottom-right, which places the inner "r" first, then "R" on the arrow to the sphere's edge, then the outer "r", then "P". The flat list cannot represent which arrow each label belongs to.
